name: secure-display-workspace
description: Experimental DRM media protection libraries; applications live only in examples/

scripts.build: npm run build -w @secure-display/core && npm run build -w @secure-display/elements && npm run build -w @secure-display/react && npm run build -w @secure-display/example-diagnostics && npm run build -w @secure-display/example-elements
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @secure-display/core && npm run build -w @secure-display/elements && npm run build -w @secure-display/react && npm run typecheck -w @secure-display/example-diagnostics && npm run typecheck -w @secure-display/example-elements
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/core/test/*.test.mjs packages/elements/test/*.test.mjs
